import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def prim_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded ∧
  -- Undirected: if u→v with weight w exists, then so does v→u with the same weight
  (∀ u v w, graph.has_edge u v w → graph.has_edge v u w)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- All graph edges that cross the cut (visited, unvisited): they leave a visited
vertex `u` and land on a vertex that has not been absorbed yet. -/
def primCandidates (g : WeightedGraph) (visited : Array Bool) : List MSTEdge :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap fun u =>
    if visited.getD u false then
      (((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.filter fun p => !visited.getD p.1 false).map
        fun p => (⟨u, p.1, p.2⟩ : MSTEdge))
    else []

/-- Least-weight element of a list of candidate edges (ties keep the earlier one). -/
def primPickMin : List MSTEdge → Option MSTEdge
  | [] => none
  | e :: rest =>
      match primPickMin rest with
      | none => some e
      | some f => some (if f.w < e.w then f else e)

/-- A minimum-weight edge crossing the cut (visited, unvisited), if one exists. -/
def primBestEdge (g : WeightedGraph) (visited : Array Bool) : Option MSTEdge :=
  primPickMin (primCandidates g visited)

/-- The main Prim loop: `k` more vertices to absorb. -/
def primLoop (g : WeightedGraph) (visited : Array Bool) (acc : List MSTEdge) :
    Nat → List MSTEdge
  | 0 => acc.reverse
  | k + 1 =>
      match primBestEdge g visited with
      | none => acc.reverse
      | some e => primLoop g (visited.setIfInBounds e.v true) (e :: acc) k

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def prim_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : prim_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  primLoop graph ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true) []
    (graph.size - 1)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def prim_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : prim_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace PrimProof

open Relation

instance instDecEqMSTEdge : DecidableEq MSTEdge := fun a b =>
  decidable_of_iff (a.u = b.u ∧ a.v = b.v ∧ a.w = b.w) (by cases a; cases b; simp)

/-! ### Reachability through a list of (undirected) edges -/

/-- Reachability using only the edges of `E`, seen as undirected. -/
def EReach (E : List MSTEdge) : Nat → Nat → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (edges_contain E)

lemma edges_contain_symm {E : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain E u v) :
    edges_contain E v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, h.symm⟩

lemma EReach_refl (E : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : EReach E u u := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

lemma EReach_single {E : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain E u v) : EReach E u v :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.single h

lemma EReach_trans {E : List MSTEdge} {u v w : Nat} (h1 : EReach E u v) (h2 : EReach E v w) :
    EReach E u w := Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h2

lemma EReach_symm {E : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : EReach E u v) : EReach E v u := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact EReach_refl _ _
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact EReach_trans (EReach_single (edges_contain_symm hstep)) ih

lemma edges_contain_mono {E F : List MSTEdge} (hs : ∀ e ∈ E, e ∈ F) {u v : Nat}
    (h : edges_contain E u v) : edges_contain F u v := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, hs e he, h⟩

lemma EReach_mono {E F : List MSTEdge} (hs : ∀ e ∈ E, e ∈ F) {u v : Nat}
    (h : EReach E u v) : EReach F u v := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact EReach_refl _ _
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact EReach_trans ih (EReach_single (edges_contain_mono hs hstep))

/-- A predicate closed under single edge steps is closed under reachability. -/
lemma EReach_closed {E : List MSTEdge} {Q : Nat → Prop}
    (hcl : ∀ x y, edges_contain E x y → Q x → Q y) {a b : Nat}
    (h : EReach E a b) (ha : Q a) : Q b := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ha
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact hcl _ _ hstep ih

/-! ### Bridging `path_follows_edges` and `EReach` -/

lemma chain'_of_index {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} :
    ∀ p : List Nat, (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → R (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) →
      List.IsChain R p
  | [], _ => by simp
  | [_], _ => by simp
  | _ :: b :: t, h => by
      refine List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨?_, chain'_of_index (b :: t) ?_⟩
      · simpa [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ] using h 0 (by simp)
      · intro i hi
        have h2 := h (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
        simpa [List.getD_cons_succ] using h2

lemma index_of_chain' {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} :
    ∀ p : List Nat, List.IsChain R p → ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
      R (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)
  | [], _, i, hi => by simp at hi
  | [_], _, i, hi => by simp at hi
  | _ :: b :: t, h, i, hi => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := List.isChain_cons_cons.mp h
      cases i with
      | zero => simpa [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ] using h1
      | succ n =>
          have h3 := index_of_chain' (b :: t) h2 n (by simpa using hi)
          simpa [List.getD_cons_succ] using h3

lemma reach_of_pfe {E : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} {p : List Nat}
    (h1 : p.head? = some u) (h2 : p.getLast? = some v) (h3 : path_follows_edges E p) :
    EReach E u v := by
  obtain ⟨_, hstep⟩ := h3
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at h1
  | cons a t =>
      have hau : a = u := by simpa using h1
      subst hau
      have hc : List.IsChain (edges_contain E) (a :: t) := chain'_of_index _ hstep
      have hlast : (a :: t).getLast (by simp) = v := by
        rw [List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil (by simp)] at h2
        simpa using h2
      exact List.relationReflTransGen_of_exists_isChain_cons t hc hlast

lemma pfe_of_reach {E : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : EReach E u v) :
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges E p := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl1, hl2⟩ := List.exists_isChain_cons_of_relationReflTransGen h
  refine ⟨u :: l, by simp, ?_, ⟨by simp, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil (by simp)]
    exact congrArg some hl2
  · exact index_of_chain' _ hl1

/-! ### Restricted reachability and the cut/exchange lemma -/

/-- `x` and `y` are the two endpoints of edge `f` (in either orientation). -/
def Ends (f : MSTEdge) (x y : Nat) : Prop := (f.u = x ∧ f.v = y) ∨ (f.u = y ∧ f.v = x)

lemma ends_iff {P : Nat → Prop} {f : MSTEdge} {x y : Nat} (h : Ends f x y) :
    ((P f.u ↔ P f.v) ↔ (P x ↔ P y)) := by
  rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> subst h1 <;> subst h2 <;> tauto

/-- One step along an edge of `E` that satisfies `P`. -/
def PStep (E : List MSTEdge) (P : MSTEdge → Prop) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ E, P e ∧ Ends e a b

/-- Reachability along edges of `E` satisfying `P`. -/
def PReach (E : List MSTEdge) (P : MSTEdge → Prop) : Nat → Nat → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (PStep E P)

lemma PReach_closed {E : List MSTEdge} {P : MSTEdge → Prop} {Q : Nat → Prop}
    (hcl : ∀ x y, PStep E P x y → Q x → Q y) {a b : Nat}
    (h : PReach E P a b) (ha : Q a) : Q b := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ha
  | tail _ hs ih => exact hcl _ _ hs ih

lemma PReach_erase {E : List MSTEdge} {P : MSTEdge → Prop} {f : MSTEdge}
    (hne : ∀ h ∈ E, P h → h ≠ f) {a b : Nat} (h : PReach E P a b) :
    EReach (E.erase f) a b := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact EReach_refl _ _
  | tail _ hs ih =>
      obtain ⟨e, he, hp, hE⟩ := hs
      exact EReach_trans ih
        (EReach_single ⟨e, (List.mem_erase_of_ne (hne e he hp)).mpr he, hE⟩)

/-- The vertices reachable from `a` without ever crossing the cut given by `S`. -/
def CutComp (M : List MSTEdge) (S : Nat → Prop) (a : Nat) : Nat → Prop :=
  PReach M (fun e => (S e.u ↔ S e.v)) a

lemma cutComp_closed (M : List MSTEdge) (S : Nat → Prop) (a : Nat) :
    ∀ v, CutComp M S a v → (S a ↔ S v) := by
  intro v hv
  refine PReach_closed (Q := fun z => (S a ↔ S z)) ?_ hv Iff.rfl
  intro x y hs hx
  obtain ⟨e, _, hp, hE⟩ := hs
  exact hx.trans ((ends_iff (P := S) hE).mp hp)

/-- Boundary lemma: if `a` and `b` are connected in `M` but separated by the set `A`,
then some edge of `M` has one endpoint in `A` and the other endpoint reachable from
`b` without crossing `A`. -/
lemma exists_boundary {M : List MSTEdge} {A : Nat → Prop} {a b : Nat}
    (hab : EReach M b a) (hAa : A a) (hAb : ¬ A b) :
    ∃ f ∈ M, ∃ x y, Ends f x y ∧ A x ∧ ¬ A y ∧ CutComp M A b y := by
  by_contra hcon
  have hnotA : ∀ v, CutComp M A b v → ¬ A v := by
    intro v hv hAv
    exact hAb ((cutComp_closed M A b v hv).mpr hAv)
  have hclosed : ∀ x y, edges_contain M x y → CutComp M A b x → CutComp M A b y := by
    intro x y hxy hRx
    obtain ⟨h, hhM, hE⟩ := hxy
    by_cases hp : (A h.u ↔ A h.v)
    · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail hRx ⟨h, hhM, hp, hE⟩
    · exfalso
      have hnAx : ¬ A x := hnotA x hRx
      have hxy' : ¬ (A x ↔ A y) := fun hq => hp ((ends_iff (P := A) hE).mpr hq)
      have hAy : A y := by tauto
      exact hcon ⟨h, hhM, y, x, hE.symm, hAy, hnAx, hRx⟩
  have hRa : CutComp M A b a := EReach_closed hclosed hab Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  exact hnotA a hRa hAa

/-- **Exchange lemma.** If `a` is inside the cut `S`, `b` outside, and they are
connected in `M`, then `M` contains an edge `f` crossing the cut such that deleting
`f` still keeps `a` connected to the inside endpoint and `b` to the outside one. -/
lemma exchange_edge {M : List MSTEdge} {S : Nat → Prop} {a b : Nat}
    (hab : EReach M a b) (ha : S a) (hb : ¬ S b) :
    ∃ f ∈ M, ∃ x y, Ends f x y ∧ S x ∧ ¬ S y ∧
      EReach (M.erase f) a x ∧ EReach (M.erase f) y b := by
  have hAa : CutComp M S a a := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  have hAb : ¬ CutComp M S a b := fun h => hb ((cutComp_closed M S a b h).mp ha)
  obtain ⟨f, hfM, x, y, hE, hAx, hAy, hRy⟩ :=
    exists_boundary (M := M) (A := CutComp M S a) (EReach_symm hab) hAa hAb
  have hSx : S x := (cutComp_closed M S a x hAx).mp ha
  have hSy : ¬ S y := by
    intro hSy
    have hpin : (S f.u ↔ S f.v) := (ends_iff (P := S) hE).mpr (by tauto)
    exact hAy (Relation.ReflTransGen.tail hAx ⟨f, hfM, hpin, hE⟩)
  have hfnotPin : ¬ (S f.u ↔ S f.v) := fun hp =>
    hSy (((ends_iff (P := S) hE).mp hp).mp hSx)
  have hfnotPout : ¬ (CutComp M S a f.u ↔ CutComp M S a f.v) := fun hp =>
    hAy (((ends_iff (P := CutComp M S a) hE).mp hp).mp hAx)
  refine ⟨f, hfM, x, y, hE, hSx, hSy, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine PReach_erase ?_ hAx
    intro h _ hp hEq
    subst hEq
    exact hfnotPin hp
  · refine EReach_symm (PReach_erase ?_ hRy)
    intro h _ hp hEq
    subst hEq
    exact hfnotPout hp

/-! ### Weights -/

lemma total_weight_eq (l : List MSTEdge) : total_weight l = (l.map (·.w)).sum := by
  have key : ∀ (l : List MSTEdge) (s : Int),
      l.foldl (fun sum e => sum + e.w) s = s + (l.map (·.w)).sum := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro s; simp
    | cons a t ih =>
        intro s
        rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_assoc]
  simpa using key l 0

lemma total_weight_cons (e : MSTEdge) (l : List MSTEdge) :
    total_weight (e :: l) = e.w + total_weight l := by
  rw [total_weight_eq, total_weight_eq]; simp

lemma total_weight_perm {l1 l2 : List MSTEdge} (h : l1.Perm l2) :
    total_weight l1 = total_weight l2 := by
  rw [total_weight_eq, total_weight_eq]
  exact (h.map _).sum_eq

lemma total_weight_append (l : List MSTEdge) (e : MSTEdge) :
    total_weight (l ++ [e]) = total_weight l + e.w := by
  rw [total_weight_eq, total_weight_eq]; simp

lemma total_weight_erase {l : List MSTEdge} {f : MSTEdge} (hf : f ∈ l) :
    total_weight l = f.w + total_weight (l.erase f) :=
  (total_weight_perm (List.perm_cons_erase hf)).trans (total_weight_cons _ _)

lemma sum_lower (c : Int) : ∀ l : List Int, (∀ x ∈ l, c ≤ x) → (l.length : Int) * c ≤ l.sum := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro h
      have h1 : c ≤ a := h a (by simp)
      have h2 := ih fun x hx => h x (by simp [hx])
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.sum_cons]
      push_cast
      linarith

/-! ### Spanning trees -/

lemma conn_iff_reach {g : WeightedGraph} {E : List MSTEdge} :
    is_connected_with_edges g E ↔ ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size → EReach E u v := by
  constructor
  · intro h u v hu hv
    obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h u v hu hv
    exact reach_of_pfe h1 h2 h3
  · intro h u v hu hv
    exact pfe_of_reach (h u v hu hv)

lemma ends_unique {f : MSTEdge} {p q x y : Nat} (h1 : Ends f p q) (h2 : Ends f x y) :
    (p = x ∧ q = y) ∨ (p = y ∧ q = x) := by
  rcases h1 with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact h2
  · exact h2.symm.imp And.symm And.symm

/-- **Cut property, exchange form.** Replacing a suitable cut edge of a spanning tree
`M` by a minimum-weight cut edge `e` again yields a spanning tree, of no larger
weight. -/
lemma spanning_exchange {g : WeightedGraph} {S : Nat → Prop} {M : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge}
    (hsym : ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → g.has_edge v u w)
    (hM : is_spanning_tree g M) (he : e.is_valid g)
    (hu : e.u < g.size) (hv : e.v < g.size)
    (hSu : S e.u) (hSv : ¬ S e.v)
    (hmin : ∀ f : MSTEdge, f.is_valid g → S f.u → ¬ S f.v → e.w ≤ f.w) :
    ∃ f ∈ M, ¬ (S f.u ↔ S f.v) ∧ is_spanning_tree g (M.erase f ++ [e]) ∧
      total_weight (M.erase f ++ [e]) ≤ total_weight M := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hval, hconn⟩ := hM
  have hreach : EReach M e.u e.v := (conn_iff_reach.mp hconn) _ _ hu hv
  obtain ⟨f, hfM, x, y, hE, hSx, hSy, hax, hyb⟩ := exchange_edge (S := S) hreach hSu hSv
  have hfcross : ¬ (S f.u ↔ S f.v) := fun hp => hSy (((ends_iff (P := S) hE).mp hp).mp hSx)
  have hfval : f.is_valid g := hval f hfM
  have hwle : e.w ≤ f.w := by
    rcases hE with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact hmin f hfval (by rw [h1]; exact hSx) (by rw [h2]; exact hSy)
    · refine hmin ⟨f.v, f.u, f.w⟩ (hsym _ _ _ hfval) ?_ ?_
      · show S f.v; rw [h2]; exact hSx
      · show ¬ S f.u; rw [h1]; exact hSy
  have hMpos : 0 < M.length := List.length_pos_of_mem hfM
  have hlenM : (M.erase f ++ [e]).length = g.size - 1 := by
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_erase_of_mem hfM]
    simp only [List.length_singleton]
    omega
  have hvalall : ∀ h ∈ M.erase f ++ [e], h.is_valid g := by
    intro h hh
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hh with h1 | h1
    · exact hval h (List.mem_of_mem_erase h1)
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h1
      subst h1; exact he
  have hsub : ∀ h ∈ M.erase f, h ∈ M.erase f ++ [e] := fun h hh => List.mem_append_left _ hh
  have hxy : EReach (M.erase f ++ [e]) x y := by
    have h1 : EReach (M.erase f ++ [e]) x e.u := EReach_symm (EReach_mono hsub hax)
    have h2 : EReach (M.erase f ++ [e]) e.u e.v :=
      EReach_single ⟨e, List.mem_append_right _ (by simp), Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    have h3 : EReach (M.erase f ++ [e]) e.v y := EReach_symm (EReach_mono hsub hyb)
    exact EReach_trans (EReach_trans h1 h2) h3
  have hstep : ∀ p q, edges_contain M p q → EReach (M.erase f ++ [e]) p q := by
    intro p q hpq
    obtain ⟨h, hhM, hEnd⟩ := hpq
    by_cases hhf : h = f
    · subst hhf
      rcases ends_unique hEnd hE with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact hxy
      · exact EReach_symm hxy
    · exact EReach_single ⟨h, hsub h ((List.mem_erase_of_ne hhf).mpr hhM), hEnd⟩
  have hconn' : is_connected_with_edges g (M.erase f ++ [e]) := by
    refine conn_iff_reach.mpr ?_
    intro p q hp hq
    exact EReach_closed (Q := fun z => EReach (M.erase f ++ [e]) p z)
      (fun a b hab hpa => EReach_trans hpa (hstep a b hab))
      ((conn_iff_reach.mp hconn) p q hp hq) (EReach_refl _ _)
  refine ⟨f, hfM, hfcross, ⟨hlenM, hvalall, hconn'⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [total_weight_append, total_weight_erase hfM]
  linarith

/-- A minimum spanning tree exists as soon as one spanning tree exists. -/
lemma exists_mst {g : WeightedGraph} (hwb : g.weights_bounded) {T0 : List MSTEdge}
    (hT0 : is_spanning_tree g T0) : ∃ M, is_mst g M := by
  classical
  have hbdd : ∃ b : Int, ∀ z : Int,
      (∃ T, is_spanning_tree g T ∧ total_weight T = z) → b ≤ z := by
    refine ⟨(g.size : Int) * (-100000), ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
    rw [total_weight_eq]
    have hlow : ∀ x ∈ T.map (·.w), (-100000 : Int) ≤ x := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      exact (hwb.2 e.u e.v e.w (hT.2.1 e he)).1
    have hs := sum_lower (-100000) _ hlow
    have hlen2 : ((T.map (·.w)).length : Int) ≤ (g.size : Int) := by
      have h := hT.1
      simp only [List.length_map]
      omega
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right hlen2 (by norm_num : (-100000 : Int) ≤ 0)
    linarith
  have hinh : ∃ z : Int, (∃ T, is_spanning_tree g T ∧ total_weight T = z) :=
    ⟨total_weight T0, T0, hT0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨lb, ⟨M, hM, hMw⟩, hmin⟩ := Int.exists_least_of_bdd hbdd hinh
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  intro other hother
  rw [hMw]
  exact hmin _ ⟨other, hother, rfl⟩

/-! ### The candidate cut edges and the minimum selection -/

/-- `v` has already been absorbed into the growing tree. -/
def Vis (visited : Array Bool) (v : Nat) : Prop := visited.getD v false = true

lemma vis_set (a : Array Bool) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < a.size) :
    Vis (a.setIfInBounds i true) j ↔ (j = i ∨ Vis a j) := by
  unfold Vis Array.getD
  simp only [Array.size_setIfInBounds]
  by_cases hj : j < a.size
  · rw [dif_pos hj, dif_pos hj]
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji; simp
    · have hij : i ≠ j := fun h => hji h.symm
      have key : a.setIfInBounds i true = a.set i true hi := by
        simp [Array.setIfInBounds, hi]
      simp only [hji, false_or, key]
      first
        | (rw [Array.getElem_set_ne]; exact hij)
        | rw [Array.getElem_set_ne hij]
        | simp [Array.getElem_set, hij, hji]
  · rw [dif_neg hj, dif_neg hj]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, or_false]
    rintro rfl
    exact hj hi

lemma pickMin_none : ∀ {l : List MSTEdge}, primPickMin l = none → l = [] := by
  intro l
  cases l with
  | nil => intro _; rfl
  | cons a t =>
      intro h
      rw [primPickMin] at h
      split at h <;> simp at h

lemma pickMin_mem : ∀ {l : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge}, primPickMin l = some e → e ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro e h; rw [primPickMin] at h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro e h
      rw [primPickMin] at h
      cases hp : primPickMin t with
      | none =>
          simp only [hp, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst h; simp
      | some f =>
          simp only [hp, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst h
          by_cases hlt : f.w < a.w
          · simp only [hlt, if_true]
            exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih hp)
          · simp [hlt]

lemma pickMin_le : ∀ {l : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge}, primPickMin l = some e →
    ∀ f ∈ l, e.w ≤ f.w := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro e h; rw [primPickMin] at h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro e h f hf
      rw [primPickMin] at h
      cases hp : primPickMin t with
      | none =>
          simp only [hp, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst h
          have : t = [] := pickMin_none hp
          subst this
          simp at hf; subst hf; exact le_refl _
      | some c =>
          simp only [hp, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst h
          have hct : ∀ z ∈ t, c.w ≤ z.w := ih hp
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf with rfl | hf'
          · by_cases hlt : c.w < f.w
            · rw [if_pos hlt]; exact le_of_lt hlt
            · rw [if_neg hlt]
          · have hz := hct f hf'
            by_cases hlt : c.w < a.w
            · rw [if_pos hlt]; exact hz
            · rw [if_neg hlt]
              push_neg at hlt
              exact le_trans hlt hz

lemma mem_candidates {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : Array Bool} {e : MSTEdge} :
    e ∈ primCandidates g visited ↔
      (Vis visited e.u ∧ ¬ Vis visited e.v ∧ g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [primCandidates, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hmem⟩ := h
    by_cases hvu : visited.getD u false = true
    · rw [if_pos hvu] at hmem
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hp
      subst hpe
      refine ⟨hvu, ?_, hu, p, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
      · simpa [Vis] using hp2
      · simpa using hp1
    · rw [if_neg hvu] at hmem
      simp at hmem
  · rintro ⟨hvu, hnv, hedge⟩
    obtain ⟨hu, p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := hedge
    have hvu' : visited.getD e.u false = true := hvu
    simp only [primCandidates, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨e.u, hu, ?_⟩
    rw [if_pos hvu']
    refine List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hp
    · simp only [hp1]
      simpa [Vis] using hnv
    · cases e with
      | mk eu ev ew => simp_all

lemma bestEdge_none {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : Array Bool}
    (h : primBestEdge g visited = none) {f : MSTEdge}
    (hf : g.has_edge f.u f.v f.w) (h1 : Vis visited f.u) (h2 : ¬ Vis visited f.v) : False := by
  rw [primBestEdge] at h
  have hnil := pickMin_none h
  have hmem : f ∈ primCandidates g visited := mem_candidates.mpr ⟨h1, h2, hf⟩
  rw [hnil] at hmem
  simp at hmem

lemma bestEdge_some {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : Array Bool} {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : primBestEdge g visited = some e) :
    Vis visited e.u ∧ ¬ Vis visited e.v ∧ g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w ∧
      ∀ f : MSTEdge, g.has_edge f.u f.v f.w → Vis visited f.u → ¬ Vis visited f.v →
        e.w ≤ f.w := by
  rw [primBestEdge] at h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := mem_candidates.mp (pickMin_mem h)
  refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, ?_⟩
  intro f hf hf1 hf2
  exact pickMin_le h f (mem_candidates.mpr ⟨hf1, hf2, hf⟩)

/-! ### The visited set as a `Finset` -/

def VSet (g : WeightedGraph) (visited : Array Bool) : Finset Nat :=
  (Finset.range g.size).filter (fun v => visited.getD v false = true)

lemma mem_VSet {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : Array Bool} {v : Nat} :
    v ∈ VSet g visited ↔ (v < g.size ∧ Vis visited v) := by
  simp [VSet, Vis]

lemma VSet_insert {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : Array Bool} {i : Nat}
    (hsz : visited.size = g.size) (hi : i < g.size) :
    VSet g (visited.setIfInBounds i true) = insert i (VSet g visited) := by
  ext v
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, mem_VSet]
  rw [vis_set visited i v (by omega)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, (rfl | h)⟩
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hv, h⟩
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    · exact ⟨hi, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨h1, Or.inr h2⟩

lemma VSet_full {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : Array Bool}
    (h : (VSet g visited).card = g.size) {v : Nat} (hv : v < g.size) : Vis visited v := by
  have hsub : VSet g visited ⊆ Finset.range g.size := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have heq : VSet g visited = Finset.range g.size :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by simp [h])
  have hmem : v ∈ VSet g visited := by rw [heq]; simp [hv]
  exact (mem_VSet.mp hmem).2

lemma vis_replicate (n j : Nat) : ¬ Vis (Array.replicate n false) j := by
  simp [Vis, Array.getD]

/-! ### Graph-level reachability -/

lemma reflTransGen_closed {α : Type} {R : α → α → Prop} {Q : α → Prop}
    (hcl : ∀ x y, R x y → Q x → Q y) {a b : α}
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen R a b) (ha : Q a) : Q b := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ha
  | tail _ hs ih => exact hcl _ _ hs ih

lemma greach_of_conn {g : WeightedGraph} (hgc : g.is_connected) {u v : Nat}
    (hu : u < g.size) (hv : v < g.size) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y => ∃ w, g.has_edge x y w) u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, _, hstep⟩ := hgc u v hu hv
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at h1
  | cons a t =>
      have hau : a = u := by simpa using h1
      subst hau
      have hc := chain'_of_index (R := fun x y => ∃ w, g.has_edge x y w) (a :: t) hstep
      have hlast : (a :: t).getLast (by simp) = v := by
        rw [List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil (by simp)] at h2
        simpa using h2
      exact List.relationReflTransGen_of_exists_isChain_cons t hc hlast

/-! ### The loop invariant of Prim's algorithm -/

lemma primLoop_spec (g : WeightedGraph)
    (hwf : g.well_formed) (hsym : ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → g.has_edge v u w)
    (hgc : g.is_connected) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (visited : Array Bool) (acc : List MSTEdge),
      visited.size = g.size →
      (∀ v, Vis visited v → v < g.size) →
      (∀ e ∈ acc, e.is_valid g) →
      (∀ e ∈ acc, Vis visited e.u ∧ Vis visited e.v) →
      (∀ u v, Vis visited u → Vis visited v → EReach acc u v) →
      acc.Nodup →
      (VSet g visited).card = acc.length + 1 →
      (VSet g visited).card + k = g.size →
      (∀ M, is_mst g M → ∃ M', is_mst g M' ∧ ∀ e ∈ acc, e ∈ M') →
      ((primLoop g visited acc k).length = g.size - 1 ∧
        (∀ e ∈ primLoop g visited acc k, e.is_valid g) ∧
        (∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size → EReach (primLoop g visited acc k) u v) ∧
        (primLoop g visited acc k).Nodup ∧
        (∀ M, is_mst g M → ∃ M', is_mst g M' ∧ ∀ e ∈ primLoop g visited acc k, e ∈ M')) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro visited acc hsz hlt hval hends hspan hnd hcard hsum hopt
      have hunfold : primLoop g visited acc 0 = acc.reverse := by simp only [primLoop]
      rw [hunfold]
      refine ⟨by rw [List.length_reverse]; omega, ?_, ?_, List.nodup_reverse.mpr hnd, ?_⟩
      · intro e he; exact hval e (List.mem_reverse.mp he)
      · intro u v hu hv
        have hVu : Vis visited u := VSet_full (by omega) hu
        have hVv : Vis visited v := VSet_full (by omega) hv
        exact EReach_mono (fun z hz => List.mem_reverse.mpr hz) (hspan u v hVu hVv)
      · intro M hM
        obtain ⟨M', h1, h2⟩ := hopt M hM
        exact ⟨M', h1, fun e he => h2 e (List.mem_reverse.mp he)⟩
  | succ k ih =>
      intro visited acc hsz hlt hval hends hspan hnd hcard hsum hopt
      cases hbe : primBestEdge g visited with
      | none =>
          exfalso
          have hne : (VSet g visited).Nonempty := by
            rw [← Finset.card_pos, hcard]; omega
          obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hne
          obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := mem_VSet.mp hs
          have hex : ∃ t, t < g.size ∧ ¬ Vis visited t := by
            by_contra hc
            push_neg at hc
            have hsubs : Finset.range g.size ⊆ VSet g visited := by
              intro v hv
              simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hv
              exact mem_VSet.mpr ⟨hv, hc v hv⟩
            have hcc := Finset.card_le_card hsubs
            simp only [Finset.card_range] at hcc
            omega
          obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩ := hex
          have hclosed : ∀ x y, (∃ w, g.has_edge x y w) → Vis visited x → Vis visited y := by
            intro x y hxy hx
            by_contra hy
            obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hxy
            exact bestEdge_none hbe (f := ⟨x, y, w⟩) hw hx hy
          exact ht2 (reflTransGen_closed hclosed (greach_of_conn hgc hs1 ht1) hs2)
      | some e =>
          have hunfold : primLoop g visited acc (k + 1) =
              primLoop g (visited.setIfInBounds e.v true) (e :: acc) k := by
            simp only [primLoop, hbe]
          rw [hunfold]
          obtain ⟨hVu, hVv, hedge, hmin⟩ := bestEdge_some hbe
          have hu : e.u < g.size := hlt _ hVu
          have hv : e.v < g.size := by
            obtain ⟨hu', p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := hedge
            have hb := (hwf e.u hu').1 p hp
            rw [hp1] at hb
            exact hb
          have hvsz : e.v < visited.size := by omega
          have hvis' : ∀ j, Vis (visited.setIfInBounds e.v true) j ↔ (j = e.v ∨ Vis visited j) :=
            fun j => vis_set visited e.v j hvsz
          have hnotmem : e.v ∉ VSet g visited := by
            simp only [mem_VSet]
            rintro ⟨_, h⟩
            exact hVv h
          have hcard' : (VSet g (visited.setIfInBounds e.v true)).card
              = (VSet g visited).card + 1 := by
            rw [VSet_insert hsz hv]
            exact Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnotmem
          have henotacc : e ∉ acc := fun hmem => hVv (hends e hmem).2
          refine ih (visited.setIfInBounds e.v true) (e :: acc) (by simp [hsz]) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
            (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨henotacc, hnd⟩) (by simp only [hcard']; simp [hcard])
            (by omega) ?_
          · intro z hz
            rcases (hvis' z).mp hz with rfl | h
            · exact hv
            · exact hlt z h
          · intro f hf
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf with rfl | hf'
            · exact hedge
            · exact hval f hf'
          · intro f hf
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf with rfl | hf'
            · exact ⟨(hvis' f.u).mpr (Or.inr hVu), (hvis' f.v).mpr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
            · obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hends f hf'
              exact ⟨(hvis' _).mpr (Or.inr a1), (hvis' _).mpr (Or.inr a2)⟩
          · have hto : ∀ x, Vis (visited.setIfInBounds e.v true) x → EReach (e :: acc) x e.u := by
              intro x hx
              rcases (hvis' x).mp hx with rfl | h
              · exact EReach_single ⟨e, by simp, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
              · exact EReach_mono (fun z hz => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz) (hspan x e.u h hVu)
            intro x y hx hy
            exact EReach_trans (hto x hx) (EReach_symm (hto y hy))
          · intro M hM
            obtain ⟨M', hM', hsubM⟩ := hopt M hM
            obtain ⟨hst', hopt'⟩ := hM'
            obtain ⟨f, hfM, hfcross, hstnew, hwnew⟩ :=
              spanning_exchange (S := fun z => Vis visited z) hsym hst' hedge hu hv hVu hVv hmin
            refine ⟨M'.erase f ++ [e], ⟨hstnew, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
            · intro other hother
              have h1 : total_weight M' ≤ total_weight other := hopt' other hother
              linarith
            · intro h hh
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp hh with rfl | hh'
              · exact List.mem_append_right _ (by simp)
              · have hne : h ≠ f := by
                  intro hEq
                  subst hEq
                  obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hends h hh'
                  exact hfcross ⟨fun _ => a2, fun _ => a1⟩
                exact List.mem_append_left _ ((List.mem_erase_of_ne hne).mpr (hsubM h hh'))

/-! ### Main correctness theorem -/

lemma prim_main (graph : WeightedGraph) (hpre : prim_mst_precond graph) :
    is_mst graph (prim_mst graph hpre) := by
  have hwf : graph.well_formed := hpre.1
  have hpos : graph.size > 0 := hpre.2.1
  have hgc : graph.is_connected := hpre.2.2.1
  have hwb : graph.weights_bounded := hpre.2.2.2.1
  have hsym : ∀ u v w, graph.has_edge u v w → graph.has_edge v u w := hpre.2.2.2.2
  have hcode : prim_mst graph hpre =
      primLoop graph ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true) []
        (graph.size - 1) := rfl
  rw [hcode]
  have hsz : ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true).size = graph.size := by
    simp
  have hvis0 : ∀ j, Vis ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true) j ↔ j = 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [vis_set _ 0 j (by simp; omega)]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | h)
      · rfl
      · exact absurd h (vis_replicate _ _)
    · rintro rfl; exact Or.inl rfl
  have hVS : VSet graph ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true) = {0} := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_VSet, Finset.mem_singleton, hvis0]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, rfl⟩; rfl
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨hpos, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hlen, hvalr, hconnr, hndr, hoptr⟩ :=
    primLoop_spec graph hwf hsym hgc (graph.size - 1)
      ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true) [] hsz
      (fun v hv => by rw [hvis0 v] at hv; omega)
      (by simp) (by simp)
      (fun u v hu hv => by
        rw [hvis0 u] at hu; rw [hvis0 v] at hv; subst hu; subst hv; exact EReach_refl _ _)
      List.nodup_nil (by rw [hVS]; simp) (by rw [hVS]; simp; omega)
      (fun M hM => ⟨M, hM, by simp⟩)
  have hst : is_spanning_tree graph
      (primLoop graph ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true) []
        (graph.size - 1)) := ⟨hlen, hvalr, conn_iff_reach.mpr hconnr⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_mst hwb hst
  obtain ⟨M', hM', hsub⟩ := hoptr M hM
  have hlenM' : M'.length = graph.size - 1 := hM'.1.1
  have hperm : (primLoop graph ((Array.replicate graph.size false).setIfInBounds 0 true) []
      (graph.size - 1)).Perm M' := by
    have hsp := List.Nodup.subperm hndr (fun x hx => hsub x hx)
    exact hsp.perm_of_length_le (by omega)
  refine ⟨hst, ?_⟩
  intro other hother
  rw [total_weight_perm hperm]
  exact hM'.2 other hother

end PrimProof
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem prim_mst_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : prim_mst_precond graph) :
    prim_mst_postcond graph (prim_mst graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  exact PrimProof.prim_main graph h_precond
  -- !benchmark @end proof
